parameters.name: CategoryCode
parameters.description: The category of the check item.

parameters.name: InspectionReportId
parameters.description: The ID of the inspection report.

parameters.name: Language
parameters.description: The language of the content. Valid values: zh-CN and en-US.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned from the previous call.
